subject: Vanta/Drata renewal: cost split & feature delta for FY27
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@vanta.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal for Redwood Inference — enterprise package

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is the renewal proposal for Redwood Inference covering SOC2 continuous monitoring, policy automation, and the new automated evidence feed we discussed. Key notes up front: a 10% customer loyalty discount (annual), a new connector for our cloud–KMS audit stream (add-on), and a proposed 12-month commitment.

I included a preliminary cost sheet and the new support SLOs in the PDF. If you'd like, I can also run a quick side-by-side export comparing the items to Drata's latest offering to highlight feature parity and gaps.

Next steps I propose:
- You review the attached and flag must-have items
- We run a short audit of evidence ingestion with your infra team (15–30 minutes)
- We get procurement terms in a redline-ready DocuSign

Thanks — happy to hop on a call with Vivek and Laura if that's helpful.

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Enterprise Account Executive | Vanta
Attachment: Vanta_proposal_Redwood_2026.pdf
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@vanta.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal for Redwood Inference — enterprise package

Sanjay — thanks for the proposal. Quick internal notes before we loop procurement:

1) Budget: our FY27 security tooling budget is tight — we are looking to keep total spend <= $120k for platform tooling (combined). Can you show an option that omits the KMS connector or makes it an optional add-on?
2) Overlap: Vivek, can you confirm whether the automated evidence feed duplicates what our internal agent (owned by infra) already writes to S3? I don't want us paying twice for the same pipeline.
3) SLAs: Laura — procurement will need the upgraded support SLOs spelled out in the DocuSign.

If Vanta can't meet budget without removing features, Elena (Drata) and I agreed to take a quick look at Drata's new feature sheet — attached is a basic comparison Elena sent over (Drata_feature_comparison_2026.xlsx). I did not share that externally — internal only for now.

Can we aim to finalize commercial terms by next Wednesday (2026-06-10)? That's when the budget commit point is.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Director, Procurement & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Drata_feature_comparison_2026.xlsx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal for Redwood Inference — enterprise package

Rachel — quick take after a 30-min sync with infra:

- The automated evidence feed from Vanta would provide some deduplication (it pulls from cloud logs + our KMS audit), but our agent currently produces a subset (S3 object-level events) and doesn't include KMS key rotation metadata. So there is incremental value, but diminished if we keep the KMS connector disabled.
- If procurement requires the KMS metadata for auditors, we should keep the connector. If we can accept a manual export for KMS events once per quarter, we could save ~30% on the first-year price.

Recommendation: ask Vanta for a modular quote: baseline platform (monitoring + policy automation) and KMS connector as paid add-on. Push for the loyalty discount + 9–12 month term.

Vivek
VP, Product Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@vanta.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal for Redwood Inference — enterprise package

Sanjay / team — thanks for the patience. After reviewing both proposals (Vanta and Drata) and running line-item comparisons, procurement is comfortable with a modular approach: baseline subscription + optional KMS connector. We are prepared to sign a 9-month commitment if the final price meets our cap.

Action items for Vanta: please provide a redline-ready DocuSign with two SKUs: (1) baseline enterprise (monitoring, policies, support SLOs) and (2) KMS connector add-on. Please apply the 10% loyalty discount to the bundle if we take both SKUs.

Procurement notes (procurement@acme-corp.com copied for process):
- We require SOC2 evidence feed sampling (attachment SOC2-feed-sample.pdf) to be included in the contract language as a deliverable.
- Please include a clause for data export within 30 days in the event of contract termination.

If we can get DocuSign by EOD Friday (2026-06-11), finance will route the PO and we can lock the FY27 commitment.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOC2-feed-sample.pdf
